Clara: Quick kick-off	Need a one-pager + short launch post for Secure Deploy (VPC + on-prem). Audience: AEs and compliance buyers. Must include SLA summary, inbound routing fields, benchmark headline, and webinar CTA.

Ethan: I can draft the AE one-pager and qualifying questions.

Maya: I'll pull perf numbers and write the benchmark blurb. Use the quantized L2-13b run as source.

Victor: I'll set up the HubSpot form. Proposed fields: deployment_choice, compliance_needs, data_residency, priority_sla.

HubSpotBot: form created -> secure-deploy-interest; utm_campaign=secure-deploy-2026 :white_check_mark:

Maya: Short benchmark headline suggestion: "Dedicated configs deliver ~2x steady throughput and ~1.4x lower cost per token for sustained workloads vs Hosted." Will include footnote on test harness.

Clara: Nice. Keep hero copy tight: "Secure, SLA-backed inference for regulated teams."

Ethan: AE cheat-sheet draft will be 1-paragraph pitch, 3 qualifying Qs, and routing rules.

Victor: Routing rule: if compliance_needs includes HIPAA or deployment_choice==Private -> route to Enterprise AE queue and notify SEs. If priority_sla checked -> add urgent tag.

Clara: Deadline: first drafts by EOD tomorrow. I'll schedule a 30m review after that. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
